card.fact_statement: The song "Supernature" was performed in French Sign Language at the 2024 Summer Olympics opening ceremony.
card.source_span: Shaheem Sanchez, a deaf dancer, performed Cerrone's "Supernature" in French Sign Language, backdropped by an elaborate light show on the Eiffel Tower
